//: Story Phase 16 crew dialogue and inspects: the Grand Search for Fire, the lighter, Coffin Sock, the Fart Zone, Agnes back, Chicken-Town, the counter (dispensary, bank, credit, converter), the hornets (Stingbeard), the bunker, the Bureau, and after.
pete.p16_after_1: pete: (eyes shut, on the lounge sofa) Sometimes, Captain. It works sometimes. That's more than most things aboard.
pete.p16_after_2: pete: Fart Zone, Fart-FREE Zone, Sash Lounge, bank, bureau. This ship's got more rooms than it's got sense.
pete.p16_bureau_1: pete[tired]: Ninety-seven pages. A Council. Vindicta in the middle of the room. I'm going to need a bigger bucket.
pete.p16_bunker_1: pete: (squashed into the bunker, happy) It's lovely in here, Captain. Nobody can fit a bank in.
pete.p16_hornets_1: pete: (at a careful distance) No offence, Stingbeard. But you're humming.
pete.p16_bank_1: pete: (on the lounge sofa) Hold my sash... hold my saaash... (opening an eye) It's got one verse, Captain.
pete.p16_mellow_1: pete: (lying down) Lie down, you said. I'm still doing it. I'm the best on the ship at it.
pete.p16_agnes_1: pete: (watching Brogath with the chicken) He's told her everything. Twice. She looks like she's taking notes.
pete.p16_zone_1: pete: A room for it. Away from everybody. Door, portholes, rope. I've never been so proud of a cupboard.
pete.p16_coffin_1: pete: (through his wet cloth) It's in my HAIR, Captain. I haven't got that much hair. It's found all of it.
pete.p16_lighter_1: pete: (with a bucket) I'm not putting it down, Captain. Not while there's a smudge bowl and a man made of cardboard in the same room.
gristle.p16_after_1: gristle: The hornets'll be back, Captain. They've got credit cards now. They've got commitments.
gristle.p16_hornets_1: gristle: (in the bunker, reinforcing it with a cushion) Hornet-proof, Captain. Mostly. One got in. It's very polite.
gristle.p16_bank_1: gristle: (inside a pile of sashes) HOLD MY SASH. I'm holding six.
gristle.p16_mellow_1: gristle: (on a cushion) These sashes, Captain. I've touched a mermaid. These are softer.
gristle.p16_coffin_1: gristle: (eyes watering) That's the smell of my granddad's wardrobe. After my granddad.
gristle.p16_lighter_1: gristle: My flint was in that sock. I'll never see either of them again.
bob.p16_after_1: bob: I've got a new rule for the board: NO LIGHTERS NEAR VINDICTA. Pete says that's every rule at once.
bob.p16_hornets_1: bob: (in the bunker) 'ASK ME ABOUT MY CEREMONIAL WAFT.' Don't. Please. It's on the sash. I didn't write it.
bob.p16_bank_1: bob: HOLD MY SASH, it says. So I am. I'm a man of my word.
bob.p16_zone_1: bob: Rule seven. One at a time. I've drawn a little arrow on the floor so they know which way to queue.
bob.p16_lighter_1: bob: I counted the matches on this ship. Twice. All thirty. All damp. I counted the damp.
jim.p16_after_1: jim: I've lit the stove, Captain. With the lighter. Took forty clicks. It's the proudest I've ever been of a stove.
jim.p16_hornets_1: jim: KISS THE COOK (NOT DOWNWIND). I made it with a pen. Nobody's read it out yet. Somebody should.
jim.p16_mellow_1: jim: (stirring an empty pot) It's soup. There's nothing in it. It's lovely.
jim.p16_coffin_1: jim: (crying, a bit) I opened the porthole and breathed. That's my whole job now. Breathing.
jim.p16_lighter_1: jim: My matches. All thirty. Damp. I kept them by the STOVE, Captain. I thought that was the dry place.
ned.p16_after_1: ned: Is the clown coming back? I've got my boot ready. Just in case.
ned.p16_hornets_1: ned: (in the bunker) I'm guarding the cushion on the door. Anchor guard, cushion guard. It's a family thing.
ned.p16_lighter_1: ned: There's a CLOWN on the Mark II, Captain. On it. Grinning. I hit it with a boot and it grinned MORE.
squawks.p16_after_1: squawks: Bad sash. Good chicken. Lighter: sometimes.
squawks.p16_coffin_2: squawks: (holding his breath, puffed up twice his size) ...
hale.p16_after_1: hale: The Sharkstorm's still going round, Captain. Same as ever. Holding her.
hale.p16_hornets_1: hale: (swatting) Hornets, Captain. On my wheel. Holding her anyway.
hale.p16_zone_1: hale: There's a room under the grating now, Captain. For farts. I'm steering round it in my head.
hale.p16_lighter_1: hale: (at the wheel) A jingle, out of the Sharkstorm, Captain. I didn't like it. I'd like that noted.
nell.p16: nell: I logged a jet of something crimson out of three portholes, heading west. I've written 'weather'.
sully.p16: sully: There's a bank in the old quarters again. And a dispensary. And a bureau. It's the same counter. It just keeps changing its hat.
wick.p16: wick: The hardtack's back. Somebody restocked it. With tokens. Bankworth says it's a 'loan'.
rook.p16: rook: A hornet asked me for a strand of my beard. I haven't got a beard. It looked so disappointed.
brask.p16: brask: Stingbeard, they called him. Just for a bit. He made us all promise not to say it. Stingbeard.
jory.p16: jory: The chicken's back! The chicken's BACK! She came round on the pillow, like he always said she would.
mags.p16: mags: I knitted the chicken another hat. She pecked the switch on Garrick's telly with it on.
quill.p16: quill: Eleven rules for the Fart Zone, twenty-four for Brogath, and a ninety-seven page application. I'm running out of board.
garrick.p16_after_1: garrick[businesslike]: Captain, I'm launching a working group on the Bureau's digital transformation. Step one: a lighter. Step two: I'll circle back.
garrick.p16_after_2: garrick[delighted]: I'm still the Grand Stenchmaster, Captain. Both crowns. I checked this morning. They're still on.
garrick.p16_bureau_1: garrick[delighted]: The Bureau of Ceremonial Ignition! Ninety-seven pages! Finally, an organisation with some AMBITION.
garrick.p16_bunker_1: garrick[proud]: The Portable Stenchmaster Entertainment System. In my COAT. For a WEEK. I'm a visionary, Captain.
garrick.p16_hornets_1: garrick[businesslike]: (out of the speaking tube) Captain, quick one: are the hornets stakeholders, or customers? Asking for the org chart.
garrick.p16_bank_1: garrick[delighted]: The BANK! I can feel my portfolio tingling. I haven't got a portfolio. I can still feel it.
garrick.p16_mellow_1: garrick: (gazing at a ladle) A spoon that's been promoted, Captain. Like me.
garrick.p16_zone_1: garrick[delighted]: HEAD OF RELEASES, Captain. Just a small plaque. Just a small desk. Just a small CROWN.
garrick.p16_coffin_1: garrick[businesslike]: Coffin Sock, Coffin Sock Lite, Coffin Sock with Notes of... (seeing your face) ...no committee.
garrick.p16_lighter_1: garrick[businesslike]: I've drafted a FIRE STRATEGY, Captain. It's three words long. 'Get some fire.'
brogath.p16_after_1: brogath[pleased]: (Agnes on his foot) A lighter, Captain. Not a Fire-Waft. Nobody had to be grand at all. I liked that.
brogath.p16_after_2: brogath[thoughtful]: Vindicta'll be back. She's always back. But the room's there. Door. Portholes. Procedure.
brogath.p16_bureau_1: brogath[mortified]: (under a cushion) In front of EVERYBODY? With a CIGARETTE? Captain, I'd rather be cardboard. I AM cardboard.
brogath.p16_bunker_1: brogath[thoughtful]: (by the speaking tube) Tell Garrick I was too shy to aim. He'll put it in the book. I want it in the book.
brogath.p16_hornets_1: brogath[proud]: It IS a good swarm, Captain. Isn't it? They love your beard. That's nearly the same as loving you.
brogath.p16_bank_1: brogath: Bankworth says I'm a VALUED SUPPLIER. I don't know what that is. It sounds distinguished.
brogath.p16_mellow_1: brogath: (lying flat, Agnes on his foot) Oh, there it is. There it always was, really.
brogath.p16_agnes_1: brogath[delighted]: (holding Agnes up) She came BACK, Captain. Through the whole Sharkstorm. For ME. (Agnes looks at the porthole.)
brogath.p16_zone_1: brogath[pleased]: Door. Portholes. Sea. Rope. I like a procedure. Nobody watching except from behind the rope.
brogath.p16_coffin_1: brogath[sorry]: (very small) That's not the green one. I KNOW it's not the green one. You don't have to say.
brogath.p16_lighter_1: brogath[bashful]: (under the canopy) It's a lovely canopy, Captain. A distinguished little tent. Is everybody looking at it?
visitor_one.p16_after_1: visitor_one: Common sense, man. Winning. Sometimes. That's the best any of us can ask.
visitor_one.p16_hornets_1: visitor_one: (in the bunker) 'I SURVIVED THE GREAT MELLOWING.' We haven't, man. We're still in it.
visitor_one.p16_mellow_1: visitor_one: (in the folding chair) You did it by not doing it, Captain. That's like... the whole thing.
visitor_one.p16_coffin_1: visitor_one: (wet cloth on his head like a hat) A coffin, man. A coffin with a sock in it. Whoa.
visitor_one.p16_lighter_1: visitor_one: A lighter, man. We HAD one. The sharks have it. I hope they're using it responsibly.
visitor_two.p16_after_1: visitor_two: Bro, that lighter worked FIRST TIME. In front of the COUNCIL. I've never been so proud of a lighter.
visitor_two.p16_hornets_1: visitor_two: STINGBEARD! Bro. STING. BEARD. I'm getting it on a sash.
visitor_two.p16_mellow_1: visitor_two: (crying) The Chicken-Town, bro. The actual one. I was THERE.
visitor_two.p16_coffin_1: visitor_two: COFFIN SOCK, bro. I named it. Well. We all named it. But I named it LOUDEST.
visitor_two.p16_lighter_1: visitor_two: A CLOWN on the TV, bro. Out of NOWHERE. Cheapy! I'd buy anything off that guy. I'd buy a lighter.
agnes_second.p16: A bit bald in places. She looks at your beard with interest, and then, wisely, at the floor.
vindicta.p16: vindicta: (lofty) Unserved, Captain. STILL. Don't think I've forgotten.
bankworth.idle: bankworth[happy]: (adjusting the vault door on his head) Solvent, Captain! Solvent as ever. Do bring the beard by. We have obligations to it.

then: bankworth: Our preferred customers send their regards. Bzz, they say. I think it's regards.

puffchester.idle: puffchester: (at the window, very patient) Three hundred and four years, clerk. I can wait a little longer. Not MUCH longer.
rancidella.idle: rancidella: (fanning herself) Fifty thousand, young man. I intend to enjoy EVERY one.
p16.inspect.grate: The cargo grating, propped open over the ladder down to the old sail locker. A sign on the coaming, in Pete's hand: FART ZONE. MIND THE LADDER. MIND EVERYTHING.
p16.inspect.fz_rules: Number nine is underlined three times.
p16.inspect.fz_door: The door has a bulge in it the exact shape of Vindicta's opinion. The iron bands held. You pat it. It's earned that.
p16.inspect.fz_bench: The observation bench, behind the rope. Spectators only. Somebody has carved PETE WAS HERE into it, and somebody else has carved AND GARRICK under it, in a different style, with a crown.
p16.inspect.canopy: Clean sashes on four poles over Brogath's spot. Loose, not sealed. It sways when he breathes out. The smudge bowl underneath is cold now: nobody needs it.

then: THE GRAND STENCHMASTER'S GRAND BANK AND GRAND TRUST. YOUR GAS IS OUR BUSINESS! The till holds {num:counter_till} Grand Tokens. None of them yours.
THE BUREAU OF CEREMONIAL IGNITION. Re-established. A stack of applications as high as the bell. On top of it, somebody has put a lighter.

p16.inspect.converter: THE GRAND CURRENCY CONVERTER. INPUT GRAND CURRENCY. OUTPUT CONVERTED ASSET. ATMOSPHERIC SETTLEMENT. It has converted {num:converter_tokens_converted} tokens so far.
p16.inspect.terminal: GRAND SASHBACK REWARDS. APPLY NOW. Cards issued: {num:sashback_cards}. The fouler the sash, the better the credit. The screen has a hornet-sized smudge on it.
p16.inspect.tube: The speaking tube, down to the bunker. You can hear somebody in there reading a sash out loud, in a voice.
p16.inspect.tube_zone: The speaking tube, up to the counter. Garrick has labelled it CAPTAIN (FOR FEEDBACK).
p16.inspect.lounge: THE SASH LOUNGE. Every clean sash on the ship, knotted into cushions. HOLD MY SASH, says every one. Everyone is.
p16.inspect.portable_tv: THE PORTABLE STENCHMASTER ENTERTAINMENT SYSTEM, GRAND TRAVEL MODEL. A fork for an aerial. A sticker on the back: KEEP AWAY FROM CHICKENS. Agnes has pecked it.
